name: Barbell Push Jerk
steps: Stand tall with a barbell racked across your front shoulders, hands just outside shoulder width, and feet hip-width apart.
Keep your torso upright and bend your knees into a shallow dip.
Drive forcefully upward through your legs, then drop quickly under the bar into a quarter squat as your arms lock straight overhead.
Stand all the way up with the bar steady overhead, then lower it under control back to your shoulders.
tips: Finish driving straight upward with your legs before dropping beneath the bar.
Receive the weight with locked elbows and active shoulders pushed upward into the bar.
